```
TYPE AutoState : (IDLE, MOVING_TO_B, WAIT_B, MOVING_TO_C, WAIT_C);
END_TYPE;

FUNCTION_BLOCK ProductionLineControl
VAR_INPUT
    Mode : BOOL;
    ForwardButton : BOOL;
    ReverseButton : BOOL;
    SensorA : BOOL;
    SensorB : BOOL;
    SensorC : BOOL;
    ButtonA : BOOL;

END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT

    MotorReverse : BOOL;
    CompletionLight : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR

    CompletionLatched : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR
```

Logic:
```
IF NOT Mode THEN
    // Manual mode
    AutoStateVar := IDLE;
    CompletionLatched := FALSE;
    CompletionLight := FALSE;
    IF ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton THEN
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        MotorReverse := FALSE;
    ELSIF ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton THEN
        MotorForward := FALSE;
        MotorReverse := TRUE;
    ELSE
        MotorForward := FALSE;
        MotorReverse := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    // Automatic mode
    MotorReverse := FALSE;
    CompletionLight := CompletionLatched AND SensorC; // maybe
    CASE AutoStateVar OF
        IDLE:
            IF SensorA AND ButtonA THEN
                AutoStateVar := MOVING_TO_B;
            END_IF;
            MotorForward := FALSE;
        MOVING_TO_B:
            MotorForward := TRUE;
            IF SensorB THEN
                AutoStateVar := WAIT_B;
                MotorForward := FALSE; // optional, next scan also false
            END_IF;
        WAIT_B:
            MotorForward := FALSE;
            IF SensorB AND ButtonB THEN
                AutoStateVar := MOVING_TO_C;
            END_IF;
        MOVING_TO_C:
            MotorForward := TRUE;
            IF SensorC THEN
                AutoStateVar := WAIT_C;
                MotorForward := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        WAIT_C:
            MotorForward := FALSE;
            IF SensorC AND ButtonC THEN
                CompletionLatched := TRUE;
            END_IF;
            IF NOT SensorC THEN
                AutoStateVar := IDLE;
                CompletionLatched := FALSE;
                CompletionLight := FALSE; // maybe
            END_IF;
    END_CASE;
    // In AUTO, ensure MotorForward false except moving states; set in each state
END_IF;
```
